title: Microsoft is Forcing me to Buy MacBooks - Windows Modern Standby
summary: Linus Tech Tips explains how Windows Modern Standby causes laptops to drain battery while asleep, arguing it makes Windows laptops hard to recommend compared to MacBooks.
why: HN links it as the standard reference whenever laptop sleep and battery drain on Windows come up, including the later point that nothing has improved.

quote.text: The Linus Tech Tips video here goes into the details
